title: ClassificationECOC Predict
text: Classify observations using error-correcting output codes (ECOC) classification model, 1 input, 3 outputs, direct feedthrough, {Select trained machine learning model} sets ECOC classification model; {Add output port for predicted class scores (negated average binary losses)} adds second output port, {Add output port for positive-class scores of binary learners} adds third output port, {Binary learner loss function}, {Decoding scheme}, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the prevention of fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Label data type} sets the data type of label output, {Label data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of label output for range checking, {Label data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of label output for range checking, {Score data type} sets the data type of score output Inherit, {Score data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of score output for range checking, {Score data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of score output for range checking, {Positive-class score data type}, {Positive-class score data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of pbscore output for range checking, {Positive-class score data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of pbscore output for range checking, {Kernel data type} sets the binary learner kernel computation data type, {Kernel data type Minimum} sets the minimum kernel computation value for range checking, {Kernel data type Maximum} sets the maximum kernel computation value for range checking, {Inner product data type}, {Inner product data type Minimum} sets the minimum of inner product term for range checking and {Inner product data type Maximum} sets the maximum of inner product term for range checking. Values come from the instance.

ports.summary: Predictor data row vector | column vector
